check.reason: The target is the system: the tech hype, billing incentives and unchanged schedule and inbox. Patients, authors and reporters are not mocked, and no private individual is targeted. There are no quotes, invented numbers, or death, children or violence. The headline and take match the real story's core finding, that note time improved while productivity did not. The 'longer notes' detail goes beyond the real headline, but it is plausibly from the summary and is framed as a finding, not invented data. The deadpan irony ('billing department may be thrilled', 'Productivity Remains Unmoved by Progress') makes it satirical.

pick.title: AI Scribes Improved Note-Taking Time but Not Productivity, Study Finds
pick.headline: AI Scribe Makes Notes Longer, Faster; Productivity Remains Unmoved by Progress
pick.take: Ambient AI cut the time physicians spend on notes and made the notes longer, while other productivity measures barely moved. No clinician has ever asked for longer notes, but the billing department may be thrilled. Revolutionary technology, meet the same schedule, the same inbox and the same system.
